summary: U.S. yields are little changed into the Fed after a sharp midweek safety bid that took the 10-year back to 5 percent. Official SOFR is 3.90 percent, but the futures strip still prices a higher path through 2027. Oil is down more than 2 percent on the session, yet WTI and Brent remain elevated near 103 and 117 as Hormuz disruption and thin spare capacity stay in the tape. Equities are firmer on the crude slide; gold holds near 4,008 and VIX is around 19. The dollar is mixed: the euro is soft on French debt, the yen firmer on AI risk-off, and USDCAD sits near 1.40 with a Bank of Canada hike poll for 28 October. Japan core CPI printed 2.1 percent, keeping normalization live. Watch the Fed, Canadian hike risk, and whether oil's drop is demand destruction or just a pause in the Hormuz shock.
